description.value: The San Juan Spruce is Canada's largest Sitka spruce and the second largest in the world, standing 62.5 metres tall with a circumference of 11.7 metres alongside the San Juan River near Port Renfrew on Vancouver Island. It is an unmanaged natural landmark accessible via a forest setting, roughly 35 minutes from Port Renfrew. Touring cyclists exploring the old-growth forests of southwestern Vancouver Island may detour to see this record-breaking ancient tree.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record identifies this as a natural tree (natural=tree) tagged as a tourism attraction, with no address, phone, or managed facilities. The website content (ancientforestalliance.org, a third-party conservation advocacy site) confirms the tree's existence and superlative status—Canada's largest Sitka spruce, ~62.5m tall, ~11.7m circumference—and provides GPS coordinates closely matching OSM. No cyclist infrastructure (bike parking, washrooms, water) is mentioned anywhere in the website content or OSM tags, as this is an unmanaged natural landmark in a forest setting.
